svg.title: Market Crossing | cuts and cantilevers
svg.desc: A longitudinal section cuts through the stepped tribune, triple-height hall, roof court, and double-height forum. Three equal-load comparisons show why the final lower chord rises at both ends.
svg.text: Heavy lines show the cut. The timber truss in tan is projected beyond the rooms.
Three glulam trusses under the same load
One truss plane · 8.35 m tributary width · 162.83 kN/m full service line load
¹ Worst occupancy pattern, 1.5× permanent deformation and 2 GN/m end springs.
² Lower-chord centreline elevations in the shared site datum.
The final cut lifts the west tip by 2.21 m and the east tip by 1.70 m above the deep Pratt.
